cases.question: 请按产品型号汇总净销售额，退款扣回原支付月份，列出各型号金额。
cases.sql: SELECT "dp"."product_id" AS "product_id", "dp"."product_name" AS "product_name", SUM("foi"."amount" - COALESCE("r"."refund_amount", 0)) AS "net_sales_amount" FROM "fact_order_item" AS "foi" JOIN "dim_sku" AS "ds" ON "foi"."sku_id" = "ds"."sku_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "ds"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" JOIN "fact_order" AS "fo" ON "foi"."order_id" = "fo"."order_id" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "fact_refund"."item_id" AS "item_id", SUM("fact_refund"."amount") AS "refund_amount" FROM "fact_refund" AS "fact_refund" GROUP BY "fact_refund"."item_id") AS "r" ON "foi"."item_id" = "r"."item_id" GROUP BY "dp"."product_id", "dp"."product_name" ORDER BY "product_id" LIMIT 1001

assumptions: 净销售额 = 订单行实付金额 - 退款金额（退款按订单行汇总）
退款归属原订单支付月份，但汇总时不按月份拆分，仅按型号汇总
仅使用核心事实表，不使用聚合快照表

cases.question: 只看2026年9月，分别列出不同销售渠道的净销售额。
cases.sql: SELECT "c"."channel_name" AS "渠道", SUM("oi"."amount" - COALESCE("r"."refund_amount", 0)) AS "净销售额" FROM "fact_order" AS "o" JOIN "dim_channel" AS "c" ON "o"."channel_id" = "c"."channel_id" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "oi" ON "o"."order_id" = "oi"."order_id" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "fact_refund"."item_id" AS "item_id", SUM("fact_refund"."amount") AS "refund_amount" FROM "fact_refund" AS "fact_refund" GROUP BY "fact_refund"."item_id") AS "r" ON "oi"."item_id" = "r"."item_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY "c"."channel_name" ORDER BY "渠道" LIMIT 1001

joins: fact_order 关联 dim_channel 获取渠道名称
fact_order_item 关联 fact_order 获取订单支付日期
fact_order_item 左连接 fact_refund 计算退款
assumptions: 净销售额 = 订单行实付金额 - 截至数据截止日该订单行的退款金额
退款归属原订单支付日，因此退款按订单支付日期过滤
只统计支付日期在2026年9月的订单

cases.question: 2026年8月按型号计算售出30天激活率，只统计观察满30天的设备，同时列出分子、分母和百分数。

cases.sql: SELECT dp.product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bod.device_id) AS total_devices, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fa.device_id IS NOT NULL AND fa.activation_date >= fo.paid_date AND fa.activation_date <= fo.paid_date + INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN bod.device_id END) AS activated_devices, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fa.device_id IS NOT NULL AND fa.activation_date >= fo.paid_date AND fa.activation_date <= fo.paid_date + INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN bod.device_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT bod.device_id), 2) AS activation_rate_pct FROM fact_order fo JOIN fact_order_item foi ON fo.order_id = foi.order_id JOIN bridge_order_device bod ON foi.item_id = bod.item_id JOIN dim_device dd ON bod.device_id = dd.device_id JOIN dim_product dp ON dd.product_id = dp.product_id LEFT JOIN fact_device_activation fa ON bod.device_id = fa.device_id WHERE fo.paid_date >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND fo.paid_date <= DATE '2026-08-31' AND fo.paid_date <= DATE '2026-09-16' GROUP BY dp.product_id ORDER BY dp.product_id

assumptions: 售出日期以订单支付日期为准
观察满30天定义为支付日期早于或等于2026-09-16（即截至2026-10-16已满30天）
激活窗口为支付日期起0至30天（含第30天）
设备去重：每台售出设备只计一次

cases.question: 2026年9月按型号统计售出30天售后设备率，同一设备多次报修只算一次，同时列出分子、分母和百分数。
cases.error: 直接表关联键不在批准关系中
cases.sql:
WITH sold_devices AS (
    SELECT
        dp.product_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bod.device_id) AS total_devices
    FROM fact_order_item foi
    JOIN fact_order fo ON foi.order_id = fo.order_id
    JOIN bridge_order_device bod ON foi.item_id = bod.item_id
    JOIN dim_device dd ON bod.device_id = dd.device_id
    JOIN dim_product dp ON dd.product_id = dp.product_id
    WHERE fo.paid_date >= DATE '2026-09-01'
      AND fo.paid_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
    GROUP BY dp.product_id
),
serviced_devices AS (
    SELECT
        dp.product_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT bod.device_id) AS serviced_devices
    FROM fact_order_item foi
    JOIN fact_order fo ON foi.order_id = fo.order_id
    JOIN bridge_order_device bod ON foi.item_id = bod.item_id
    JOIN dim_device dd ON bod.device_id = dd.device_id
    JOIN dim_product dp ON dd.product_id = dp.product_id
    JOIN fact_service_ticket fst ON bod.device_id = fst.device_id
    WHERE fo.paid_date >= DATE '2026-09-01'
      AND fo.paid_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND fst.created_date >= fo.paid_date
      AND fst.created_date <= fo.paid_date + INTERVAL 30 DAY
    GROUP BY dp.product_id
)
SELECT
    sd.product_id,
    sd.total_devices AS denominator,
    COALESCE(sv.serviced_devices, 0) AS numerator,
    CASE WHEN sd.total_devices > 0 THEN (COALESCE(sv.serviced_devices, 0) * 100.0 / sd.total_devices) ELSE 0 END AS percentage
FROM sold_devices sd
LEFT JOIN serviced_devices sv ON sd.product_id = sv.product_id
ORDER BY sd.product_id;

assumptions: 观察满30天售出设备，支付日起0至30天有工单的设备去重数/售出设备去重数；包含退款设备；不是工单数占比

cases.question: 请比较2026年8月不同固件版本的设备离线率，同时返回设备日记录数和百分数。
cases.sql: SELECT "f"."firmware_id" AS "firmware_id", COUNT(*) AS "total_device_days", SUM(CASE WHEN "d"."online" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "offline_device_days", ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "d"."online" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "offline_rate_percent" FROM "fact_device_day" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "dim_firmware" AS "f" ON "d"."firmware_id" = "f"."firmware_id" WHERE "d"."event_date" >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND "d"."event_date" <= CAST('2026-08-31' AS DATE) GROUP BY "f"."firmware_id" ORDER BY "firmware_id" LIMIT 1001

assumptions: 离线率 = 当日 online=0 的设备日记录数 / 当日总设备日记录数
仅统计 2026 年 8 月内的设备日记录
按固件版本分组，返回每个固件版本的设备日记录数和离线率百分数

cases.question: 请按型号展示最近一个库存快照日的结存数量，不要累加多个日期。
cases.sql: SELECT "dp"."product_id" AS "product_id", SUM("fid"."quantity") AS "total_quantity" FROM "fact_inventory_day" AS "fid" JOIN "dim_sku" AS "ds" ON "fid"."sku_id" = "ds"."sku_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "ds"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" WHERE "fid"."stock_date" = (SELECT MAX("fact_inventory_day"."stock_date") AS "_col_0" FROM "fact_inventory_day" AS "fact_inventory_day") GROUP BY "dp"."product_id" LIMIT 1001

assumptions: 选择范围内最新快照日的库存，不跨日期累计库存快照
